item.title: Ford affordable crossover tipped at $25,000 for 2029
item.summary: Ford is reportedly preparing a new low-cost compact crossover for the US market with a starting price of about $25,000 and an expected launch in 2029. According to an Ars Technica report, Ford showed mock-ups of the vehicle to dealers at a private meeting in Las Vegas, where executives outlined both petrol and hybrid versions.
